title: Python for-loops: iterator protocol, tracing, and correctness reasoning
learning_objective: Python for-loops consume iterables through the iterator protocol, bind target names each iteration, and require state tracing plus invariants for correctness reasoning.; Students explain their reasoning using evidence from the worked example.; Students identify and repair at least one common misconception during guided practice.
common_misconceptions: One written loop-body line means only one execution.
range stop values are included, so range(3) yields 1, 2, 3.
A loop that works on one representative input is proven correct.
